basic_info.description:
Welcome to your dream home at 1819 41st Ave, a beautifully renovated single-family residence in the heart of Sunset San Francisco. This stunning 3-bedroom, 3-bathroom property spans 1,784 square feet, offering a perfect blend of modern luxury and comfort.
Step inside to discover gorgeous hardwood floors and an abundance of natural light, recessed lighting and a thoughtfully placed skylight. The chef's kitchen, featuring stainless steel appliances, and an open layout that seamlessly connects to the living and dinning spaces. Cozy up next to the inviting fireplace or retreat to the home office for work or study in the backyard.
The primary suite offers a serene escape with its ensuite bathroom and spacious walk-in closet. Entertain guests on the private roof deck with breathtaking panoramic ocean views, equipped with a freestanding spa tub in the patio ideal for relaxing.This home presents a true ocean oasis with beach accessa surfers dream. Surrounded by vibrant cultural dining and soulful restaurants, and just minutes from premier organic markets, it offers coastal lifestyle and everyday convenience.
Experience the perfect blend of indoor and outdoor living in this remarkable home, a true sanctuary in Sunset. Claim this charming home to yours!
